title: GpuMemoryReservation
description: A logical resource reservation in the rebalancer ledger. Legacy reservations remain valid. contractVersion 1 adds authority-owned idempotency, fencing, evidenced safe-peak quantities and monotonic progress leases; producer timestamps are display-only.

contractVersion.description: Presence selects the additive runtime-reservation contract. Absence is the legacy specs/46 reservation shape.

reservationId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

decisionId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable across retries of the same logical reservation; the authority returns the same reservation and never double-books it.

fencingEpoch.description: Monotonic authority epoch. Commands carrying an older epoch cannot load, mutate or release the reservation.

gatewayId.description: A node or gateway id: printable ASCII without spaces and without '/', the separator of GPU resource ids.

resourceId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

physicalResourceKey.description: Stable physical de-duplication key excluding advertising parent. GPU grants name the stable node/device; CPU-only grants name the stable host capacity domain.

parentId.description: Advertising path provenance only; never part of physicalResourceKey.

placementGroupId.description: Required by contractVersion 1. All per-GPU rows of one atomic multi-GPU placement share it; host CPU RAM and disk safe peaks are charged once per placement group and resourceDomainKey.

modelId.description: Printable ASCII without spaces, so 128 characters is 128 UTF-8 bytes on every reader.

placementClass.description: Absent means normal. A reader that meets a value it does not know treats it as primary (never evicted, never packed against).

requestedBytes.description: Initial contractVersion 1 grants require this GPU byte hold to be at least resourceEnvelope.gpuSafePeak.bytes; normally equal. CPU-only grants use zero.

effectiveBytes.description: Initial contractVersion 1 grants require this to cover gpuSafePeak.bytes. It may shrink only as the runtime allocation becomes physical, preventing double subtraction.

gpuContributors.description: Each safe-peak contributor is an evidenced Quantity; unknown and unsupported quantities cannot be admitted.

gpuSafePeak.description: At least the sum of all six contributors plus gpuHeadroom and no more than available GPU bytes. Basis is estimated/low if any input is estimated; otherwise derived/medium.

gpuCount.description: contractVersion 1 uses one grant per GPU; multi-GPU placements share placementGroupId across per-device grants. CPU-only grants use zero.

accelerator.description: CPU-only universal-family deployments use cpu, gpuCount 0 and an empty deviceIds array; no fake GPU worker is created.

deviceIds.description: Exactly one stable device id for a GPU grant and empty for CPU. Multi-GPU placements use one fenced reservation per device.

lastProgressAt.description: Timestamp of the latest observable monotonic progress event. A lease may expire only when this fails to advance for the negotiated progress timeout.

progressSequence.description: Monotonic progress sequence used to distinguish a live long load from an abandoned reservation.

createdAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (producer clock; display only).

expiresAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp (producer clock; display only).

progressTimeoutMs.description: Authority-selected negotiated no-progress interval for this reservation.

authorityClock.description: Lease evaluation uses only the reservation authority monotonic clock; producer wall timestamps never extend a lease.

lastProgressAuthorityTick.description: Opaque authority-local monotonic millisecond observation tick.

leaseDeadlineAuthorityTick.description: Authority-local deadline equal to the last accepted progress observation plus progressTimeoutMs.

resourceDomainKey.description: Stable host capacity domain used to aggregate CPU RAM and disk safe peaks across reservations on distinct accelerators.

payloadDigest.description: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 of requestIdentity only, rendered sha256:<lowercase hex>. payloadDigest itself and all authority outputs are excluded.

requestIdentity.description: Exact non-self-referential payloadDigest input. Contains only strings; authority outputs, payloadDigest, idempotencyKey, fencingEpoch, progress, lease and timestamps are excluded.
